test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

C _ L L A_ _ O L _ A R CO_ L _ R

options.text: C O L L A R
O R C L L A
C L L R O L
R A L O C R

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: C _ L L A_ _ O L _ A R CO_ L _ R 

Now, put the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) C O L L A R → C __**C**__ L L A __O__ / __**L**__ O L __L__ A R / CO **__A__** L __**R**__ R 

Option 2) O R C L L A → C __**O**__ L L A __R__ ./ __C__ O L __L__ A R / CO __L__ L __A__ R 

Here, 'COLLAR' followed a pattern. 

Option 3) C L L R O L → C __C__ L L A __L__ / __L__ O L __R__ A R / CO __O__ L __L__ R 

Option 4) R A L O C R → C __R__ L L A __A__ / __L__ O L __O__ A R / CO __C__ L __R__ R 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
